title: One-carbon metabolism-derived prognostic signature orchestrates reactive oxygen species redox homeostasis in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: integrative bulk and single-cell transcriptomic profiling.
snippet: Dysregulated onecarbon metabolism drives tumor progression and redox homeostasis by modulating reactive oxygen species balance, yet robust onecarbon metabolismderived prognostic biomarkers for head and neck squamous cell carcinoma remain insufficiently defined.
